title: Enterprise release blocker closure: execute accuracy evidence and close or keep blocked release claims honestly
goal: Turn the current enterprise release-readiness no-go into current, evidence-backed truth by executing the validation matrix and updating the support-claim ledger without lowering gates or inventing proof.
scope: Run and repair only the existing release-readiness evidence path: known-vulnerability validation matrix execution, false-positive/false-negative posture, support-claim ledger refresh, and operator-readable blocker list. This task is the closure pass after runner/tool coverage work; it must either produce current pass evidence or leave explicit blockers with next-task references.
generation_reason: The existing release-readiness gate is blocked because accuracy evidence is stale or not executed. Enterprise readiness needs a dedicated closure task after tool/runners work, not another broad roadmap item.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Evidence closure only. Do not fake results, relax thresholds, mark unsupported capabilities as supported, or add unrelated runners in this task.

success_criteria: The validation matrix is executed against safe/local benchmark targets or every blocked scenario records the exact blocker and safest next step.
codex/results/validation-matrix-latest.json contains a current expected-vs-actual verdict instead of not_run/stale status.
Enterprise release-readiness outputs are regenerated from current evidence.
The release gate remains no-go if critical evidence is missing and lists concrete next task references.
Human-readable output explains detection reliability, false-positive/false-negative posture, skipped scenarios, and unsupported claims without marketing overclaim.

acceptance_criteria: Accuracy evidence is current and machine-readable, or blockers are explicit and fail closed.
The enterprise-ready claim is allowed only when the gate has current evidence for required claims.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the only active task.
after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.

out_of_scope: Changing thresholds only to get a green release gate
